schema_version.description: The shape of the file, semver. Stays 1.x.y within /api/v1/, where fields and files are only ever added.

date.description: A calendar date, ISO 8601, no time zone (Hubverse dates).

timestamp.description: A moment, RFC 3339, always in UTC and to the second: 2026-10-31T07:02:11Z.

series_id.description: A series' public, permanent ID: its path segment and its Hubverse target.

model_id.description: Hubverse team_abbr-model_abbr. A new model or new inference settings get a new ID.

forecast_mode.description: live: issued by the daily run, from the newest data. retrospective: issued after the fact (the launch backfill, or an earlier day of a batch); never counted in the live record.

horizon_unit.description: What a forecast step is: a calendar day, or a trading day for a price that has none on weekends and market holidays (Brent).

level.description: A quantile level as a string key, one of the 21 Timestral levels.

path.description: A file of this API, relative to the file that names it, or to /api/v1/ for a licence text.

number_or_null.description: A number, or null where there is none (JSON has no NaN).

license.description: The terms a resource is under, and what must travel with it.

text.description: The full licence text, or the terms, served under /api/v1/.

modifications.description: What aseri changed, as CC BY and the IMF terms require it be stated.
